description: i017 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=csum-partial-consumer-trust) complete. One finding, medium confidence: net/core/skbuff.c:3522-3546 skb_copy_and_csum_dev() — a CHECKSUM_PARTIAL consumer that writes csum_fold(csum) to `to + (csstart + skb->csum_offset)` (line 3542-3544) with no re-validation of skb->csum_start/skb->csum_offset against skb headroom/headlen or the destination buffer size; the only guard is BUG_ON(csstart > skb_headlen(skb)) and csum_offset is entirely unchecked. Six in-tree callers (8139too.c:1731, via-rhine.c:1800, ep93xx_eth.c:350, sc92031.c:957, ksz884x.c:4795, ec_bhf.c:291) pass fixed-size driver TX bounce buffers as `to`, so an skb with an unvalidated csum_offset (up to 65535, small headlen) from any inconsistently-validated CHECKSUM_PARTIAL producer (the seed-mechanism TOCTOU class) yields an OOB write into adjacent driver memory. Counterevidence: sibling sinks skb_checksum_help (net/core/dev.c:3260, WARN_ON_ONCE offsets) and pskb_trim_rcsum_slow (net/core/skbuff.c:2494, offset+2<=hdlen check) both re-validate; this function does not. 14 other candidates classified safe with concrete evidence (pskb_trim_rcsum_slow, skb_checksum_help, skb_csum_hwoffload_help, skb_partial_csum_set, __bpf_skb_min_len, fou_core GUE remcsum, ip_vs_xmit GUE encap, hsr_forward ±HSR_HLEN, sunvnet vnet_skb_shape, vmxnet3 bounds-checked descriptors, thunderbolt, vxlan remcsum, virtio_net_hdr_to_skb, af_packet vnet parse, gve/descriptor-only drivers); xsk.c in s04 has no TX-metadata checksum path at all (grep for csum in net/xdp returns nothing), so the seed producer itself is absent from this snapshot. Limitations: no in-snapshot inconsistently-validated producer proven (finding is conditional, hence medium confidence); driver descriptor consumers triaged by value-flow not line-by-line; GRO/GSO/tls/netfilter producers treated as consistent-by-construction; mac80211 tx.c ofs path and fcoe/fnic/snic not deeply read. Artifacts: agent-state/findings/i017.json (finding + 16 candidates + 4 limitations, quote verified literal in range) and agent-state/checkpoints/i017.json.
